question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a orange present, Bob has a black present, and Claire has a grey present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Finally, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Alice has the
Options:
(A) orange present
(B) black present
(C) grey present
solution:
Present colors in every row are listed for (Alice, Bob, Claire).
Initial: (orange, black, grey)
1. Alice and Bob swap: (black, orange, grey)
2. Claire and Bob swap: (black, grey, orange)
3. Alice and Bob swap: (grey, black, orange)
Alice has the grey present, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
